steps.en: OCMS receives enable/disable payment requests from PLUS
steps.id: OCMS menerima request enable/disable pembayaran dari PLUS

steps.en: Request has notice number, amount, due date and a Y/N flag
steps.id: Request berisi nomor notice, jumlah, tanggal jatuh tempo, dan flag Y/N

steps.en: OCMS rejects notice numbers that do not exist
steps.id: OCMS menolak nomor notice yang tidak ada

steps.en: OCMS checks the notice is a court notice and unpaid
steps.id: OCMS mengecek notice adalah court notice dan belum dibayar
steps.why_en: Unpaid is checked, but the court-stage check is missing on this main path.
steps.why_id: Status belum bayar dicek, tapi pengecekan tahap court tidak ada di jalur utama ini.

steps.en: Amount and payment flag are saved on the notice
steps.id: Jumlah dan flag pembayaran disimpan pada notice

steps.en: Due date and remarks are saved with the court case
steps.id: Tanggal jatuh tempo dan catatan disimpan bersama data court case

steps.en: The public portal sees the same flag and amount
steps.id: Portal publik melihat flag dan jumlah yang sama

steps.en: PLUS gets a success or failure result for each notice
steps.id: PLUS menerima hasil berhasil atau gagal untuk tiap notice
